messages:
Ivy (Sales): Urgent: ClearHarbor POC is hitting 429s intermittently during a large sandbox import. Demo with execs in 90m. They also asked whether temporary reservations change billing and want a short security blurb for their questionnaire. acct:CLR-9001.

Marcus (SE): Which endpoints, and can you paste sample response headers/body? Also estimated concurrency and batch size pls.

Ivy (Sales): Mainly /v1/embeddings. They run ~40 lambdas, each ~2 req/s, occasionally spiking to 110rps for ~30s. Example response: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 180
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2490001245
Body: {"error":"rate_limited","detail":"per_route_window_exhausted"}

Felipe (Infra): "per_route_window_exhausted" => route-level burst window drained by many small requests. Account quota still has headroom. Short-term: temporary per-route reservation. Medium: batching + preflight reservation for POCs.

Marcus (SE): If they can’t change code before the demo, we should apply a short reservation. Ivy, want me to request +250 rps for /v1/embeddings for 3h?

Rae (Oncall): I can apply and enable extra tracing. Also recommend we add a customer-facing note explaining batching vs per-request accounting.

Ivy (Sales): Please apply and include a one-line I can paste to the execs. Also they want to know whether reservations will be charged to their card.

quota-bot: Temporary reservation applied: +250 rps to route "/v1/embeddings" for acct:CLR-9001 until 2490003650. Ticket CH-5601. :white_check_mark:

Hannah (Finance): Short answer for customer: trial support reservations are provided as a courtesy and are not billed during the POC. We record usage for conversion analysis only. I'll follow up via email for any exceptions.

Nora (Security): For the security questionnaire: "Sandbox workloads run in the region selected at signup. For regulated data we recommend Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) which supports KMS/HSM, audit logs, and SOC2 controls. Contact enterprise@redwood.ai for details." Feel free to paste.

Marcus (SE): Pasted mitigation to customer: "We applied a temporary +250 rps reservation to your embeddings route for the upcoming demo (expires in ~3h). For production imports, we recommend batching up to 64 items/call and adding exponential backoff on 429s. SE will follow up on a preflight reservation for longer runs."

Ivy (Sales): They asked for quick code hints to add retries client-side if they want to be defensive. Marcus, can you drop a short snippet?

Marcus (SE): Quick Python retry/backoff to paste: ```python
import time,random
for i in range(6):
    r = client.embeddings.create(items=batch)
    if r.status_code==429:
        time.sleep((2**i)*0.1 + random.random()*0.05)
        continue
    break
```

Felipe (Infra): Note for internal follow-ups: embeddings are billed per-item but also drive request-rate consumption. When customers send one-row-per-request, effective QPS can be much higher than token volume suggests. Add to runbook.

Rae (Oncall): Demo ran; import finished at 2490001328, no more 429s. I'll keep tracing on until the TTL and then revoke.

Ivy (Sales): Execs confirmed demo success. I'll add Hannah and Nora to the customer ticket for billing and security notes.

Hannah (Finance): Confirmed—no charge for the temporary POC reservation; we'll document this in the SE canned replies.

Nora (Security): Added a short security answer to the ticket. Also offered to schedule a short call if they need more detailed compliance attachments.

Marcus (SE): Follow-ups: 1) update SE POC preflight checklist (expected QPS, batch size, lead time for reservation), 2) add an SDK quickstart note about batching for bulk imports, 3) include a one-line billing policy about trial reservations in the canned SE replies.

Felipe (Infra): I'll file an RFC for a small opt-in sandbox reservation product and a console preflight warning when many small requests are detected.

Ivy (Sales): Great work team 680. Closing this thread once ticket CH-5601 is closed. Thanks! :thumbsup:
